collx_appstore.text: ‎CollX: Sports Card Scanner App - App Store Search Today Games Apps Arcade Platform iPhone iPad Mac Vision Watch TV CollX: Sports Card Scanner Scan, price, buy + sell cards Free · In‑App Purchases · Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS. Share 49K Ratings 4.6 Age Rating 4+ Years Chart #32 Sports Developer CollX LLC Language EN English Size 225.2 MB iPhone, iPad CollX (pronounced "collects") answers the question every collector has: "What's it worth?" The app lets you scan virtually any sports, trading card game, or non-sport card! That includes baseball, basketball, football, wrestling, hockey, soccer, MMA, boxing, golf, tennis— as well as TCG cards like Pokemon, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Flesh & Blood, One Piece, Disney Lorcana, and even Non-Sport categories like Garbage Pail Kids, Marvel, and Star Wars. CollX will instantly identify the card and get the average market value. Once you've scanned your cards, add them to your collection and track your portfolio. You can also buy and sell via the CollX marketplace, where you can purchase cards with a credit card, get shipping and tracking, and earn cash selling your cards to other collectors. Turn the hobby into your side hustle! COLLX SPORTS AND TCG SCANNER CollX's visual search technology instantly recognizes and matches against a database of 20+ million cards. After identifying the best match, you'll get the current average market price for the card. Our deep-learning models were created by a team with 10+ years experience developing image recognition technology. In addition to being able to match most RAW cards, CollX will also identify graded cards, as well as parallel and reprint versions of cards. BUY AND SELL The CollX marketplace is the fastest growing place to buy and sell cards. Use Deals to bundle multiple cards and make an offer to the Seller. As a Seller, you can utilize several shipping options, including CollX Envelope, where you'll get tracked shipping for as little as $0.75! Other Seller Tools include the ability to set a bulk discount, accept offers, and vacation mode. Cards bought through the CollX marketplace are covered by CollX Protect, where payments are only released when the cards arrive at the Buyer, giving peace of mind to both parties in a deal. COLLX AI The first AI built specifically for the trading card hobby, CollX AI provides insights on cards, coaching tips on how to do everything from negotiate to ship, and even can assist in helping sell your cards faster. GO PRO CollX Pro is a monthly subscription tier on CollX offering several power-user features, including: - Unlimited Collection Size - $10 Monthly Credit on CollX Marketplace - Featured Listings - Access to CollX AI - EasyPrice (dynamic repricing) - Export Collection as CSV spreadsheet - Printable Checklists And much much more! CollX Pro is $10/month or $100/year. GET HISTORICAL PRICING CollX uses millions of historical auction prices to calculate a card's average value. As you add cards to your collection, you'll see your overall portfolio value grow. As your cards rise or fall in value, CollX helps you track both individual card values and your overall portfolio value. No more wondering what your Pokémon card value is! BUILD YOUR CARD COLLECTION Create and keep track of your card values. View your collection as a grid, list, or as sets. You can also filter and sort your cards by a variety of criteria — value, date added, year, team, etc. Export as spreadsheet and generate set checklists with CollX Pro. SEARCH CARDS Search 20+ million cards in our database or the millions of CollX user cards for sale. Save your favorite searches to get email, push or in-app notifications when those cards are added for sale. When you click on links to various merchants on this site and make a purchase, this can result in this app earning a commission. Affiliate programs include, but are not limited to, the eBay Partner Network. Read our Terms of Use at https://www.collx.app/terms more Ratings & Reviews 4.6 out of 5 49K Ratings Best app ever, but one I can no longer use! I’ve been with collx for about 6-7 months and even though I was invited at month 3 to join the ambassadors program I held back after reading the requirements for joining because I didn’t meet them all. Promising but lots of bugs 07/08/2024 Ironkerrtain I don’t do any buying or selling, just use the app to catalog my player and vintage collections so when I go to card shows I know what I already own. It works great for that but I have a few issues. One is that the app constantly incorrectly identifies cards. I get that modern cards have a crazy amount of variations, but I can scan a base card and it thinks it’s a rare variant, which then makes cataloging take much longer when I have to manually change almost every card I scan. I especially find it frustrating when scanning vintage baseball cards. For example I scanned a 1959 Topps Willie Mays, front and back of card, and the app thought it was a reprint from 1994. This happens very regularly and I’m not sure why. The next issue I came across was that I wanted to retake some of my photos with better lighting. I hit edit on a card and chose retake photos and updated them. Did this on a bunch of cards and then came to find all the old photos were back. Kept trying to replace again and taking yet again new photos, and same thing happened. Only thing to solve the issue was to delete the card from my collection and add it fresh again, but because of the above issue with the app not choosing the right card, I have to manually correct it. This becomes extremely frustrating cause the app is great in concept but several issues keep it from being a go to and I will need to rethink subscribing to the pro tier until these issues can be ironed out.
